verdict.rationale: Sentry's own API documents a 'Bulk Mutate a List of Issues' endpoint, a first-party way to change many issues in one operation. The evidence is only that page title, with no detail on which fields can be changed, batch limits, or bulk support for other object types. Missing for 10: documented scope of bulk mutations (status, assignment, merge, delete), bulk operations beyond issues, bulk actions exposed through the MCP server or CLI for AI-native workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
